name: Huffman Entropy Coder
description: cuSZ Huffman entropy coder (T = u8/u16/u32). Lossless. Supports host-coordinated and GPU-assembled coarse paths. Byte-transparent output.

config.name: bklen
config.description: Codebook length (distinct symbols). Default 256 for u8, 1024 for u16/u32. Must be <= 2^(8*sizeof(T)).

config.name: executionMode
config.description: DeviceResident performs canonical book construction, partition scan, stream assembly, and header parsing on the GPU for every book source; only terminal Fixed is CUDA Graph compatible.

paper.title: cuSZ: An Error-Bounded Lossy Compressor for GPU Scientific Data
